premises.text: Cancer patients at home between treatments lack monitoring of blood counts and vitals, so infections cause hospitalizations and delay chemo
premises.evidence_span: 50% of cancer patients undergoing treatment suffer from low white blood cell counts that lead to an infection and a delay in cancer-fighting treatment

premises.text: Current at-home monitoring methods miss critical health information
premises.evidence_span: Current methods of monitoring patients at home are missing critical health information

premises.text: NextGen Port is an implanted smart chemo port that detects early infection signs by measuring blood cell counts, heart function, and vitals via microelectronics and optical sensors
premises.evidence_span: NextGen Port is the first of its kind implanted smart port that detects early signs of infection by measuring changes in blood cell counts, heart function, and vitals

premises.text: Between treatments, machine-learning software watches longitudinal data for health-status changes before symptoms emerge
premises.evidence_span: our software uses machine learning to look for changes in health status before symptoms emerge

premises.text: Findings reach physicians through an API integrated with electronic medical records so they can act before hospitalization
premises.evidence_span: We analyze the longitudinal data and pass the findings on to physicians through an API integrated with their electronic medical records

premises.text: Unlike wearables and clinic lab tests, the implanted port gathers blood and vitals data continuously without extra patient burden
premises.evidence_span: Wearables can't track blood and they have low levels of patient engagement. Lab tests can measure blood, but require patients to drive to clinic

premises.text: Go-to-market is selling the technology to port manufacturers with a clear FDA 510(k) and reimbursement roadmap
premises.evidence_span: GoToMarket focuses on selling the technology to port manufacturers

domains.name: Smart port sensing and ML alerts

value.text: Early detection of infection risk at home so physicians can deliver life-saving care before hospitalization
value.evidence_span: detect early signs of infection before they even had symptoms

secondary_value.text: Save over a billion dollars by avoiding preventable hospitalizations
